roleLabel: Poison Tank — front-line cloud that stacks Poison while the board forms behind her
bestFor: Debuff / Stall boards and any run that needs a true engage anchor before the carry comes online
strength: Pepper Spray turns Defense into cloud damage and Poison; she holds space instead of racing DPS
weakness: Clear is slow if nobody else damages; she is not a solo win condition

howToPlay.early: Excellent first or second pickup when packs punish fragile openers. Buy Defense so the cloud hurts; do not expect her to delete elites alone.
howToPlay.mid: Spicy = auto-attack multiplies existing Debuffs. Seasoned = bigger/longer cloud plus Tank/Mage Defense after Stall. Lover = permanent AS for heroes directly behind her (huge with Sal). Pick based on whether you want personal shred, team peel, or a fixed formation pair.
howToPlay.late: Keep Stall/Defense coming. Pair Debuff relics so Spicy has stacks to amplify. With Lover, lock Sal (or another carry) in the tile behind her.
howToPlay.positioning: True front-center on the engage path. Lover only pays if someone valuable stands in the tile directly behind — check formation every fight.

abilityNotes.Pepper Spray: The cloud is her job. More Defense means more Poison and tick damage — itemize tank stats before Magic greed.

specNotes.The Spicy: Take when enemies already wear Debuffs (Poison/Frost/Burn boards). She shreds stacked targets on autos.
specNotes.The Seasoned: Take for a bigger cloud and Stall Defense for Tanks/Mages — best pure tank-support path.
specNotes.The Lover: Formation path with Sal synergy. Take only if you will keep a carry directly behind her every combat.

relicReasons.tanks-patience-banner-521: Stall/patience tools help her cloud and Seasoned windows matter.
relicReasons.tanks-invigoration-filigree-3003: Tank identity piece that keeps the front line online.
relicReasons.defensive-amplifier-2016: Defense amp feeds Pepper Spray’s Defense scaling.

faq.question: Is Pimenta good in Guildrun?
faq.answer: Yes as a front-line anchor. No as your only damage. Shop rule: buy her to stop dying early, then add a carry.

faq.question: What class is Pimenta?
faq.answer: Tank. Role focus: Poison cloud frontliner and formation anchor (especially with Lover + Sal).

faq.question: What relics work with Pimenta?
faq.answer: Tank Patience/Invigoration pieces, defensive amplifiers, and Debuff enablers if you took Spicy.

faq.question: How do you play Pimenta?
faq.answer: Park her on first contact, stack Defense, let Pepper Spray cook, and either widen the cloud (Seasoned) or lock a carry behind her (Lover).

tips: Lover without a hero behind her is a wasted Rank B — move someone or respec fantasy.
If the cloud is empty, you misplaced the fight — fix pathing before buying more damage relics.
